questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A $90\,\Omega$ galvanometer has a $10\,\Omega$ shunt. What fraction of the total current flows through each branch?

options.text: $1/90$ through the galvanometer and $1/10$ through the shunt
$1/10$ through the galvanometer and $1/90$ through the shunt
$1/10$ through the galvanometer and $9/10$ through the shunt
$9/10$ through the galvanometer and $1/10$ through the shunt

questions.solution: The parallel branches have equal voltage, so $I_g/I_s=R_s/R_g=1/9$. Hence $I_g/I=1/10$ and $I_s/I=9/10$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Two objects separate at $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ in the same direction and approach at $8\,\mathrm{m/s}$ when facing each other. Find their speeds.
questions.solution: Let the speeds be $u>v$. Then $u-v=6$ and $u+v=8$, giving $u=7$ and $v=1\,\mathrm{m/s}$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Eleven consecutive wave crests span $1\,\mathrm{m}$. If speed is $30\,\mathrm{m/s}$, find the frequency in hertz.
questions.solution: Eleven crests define ten wavelengths, so $\lambda=1/10\,\mathrm{m}$. Then $f=v/\lambda=30/0.1=300\,\mathrm{Hz}$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Three charges $+q$ occupy the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side $a$. What is their total potential energy?
questions.solution: There are three pairs of charges, each separated by $a$ and contributing $kq^2/a$; the total is $3kq^2/a$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: Transfer of whole numbers of which particle demonstrates the quantization of electric charge?
questions.solution: An electron carries one elementary charge $-e$; transferred charge is an integer multiple of $e$.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: A full-wave rectifier receives a $50\,\mathrm{Hz}$ AC input. What is the output frequency?
questions.solution: Full-wave rectification produces two pulses per input cycle, so $f_{\mathrm{out}}=2f_{\mathrm{in}}=100\,\mathrm{Hz}$.
